publicationUnknown: Repository version could not be confirmed
nativeBuildRequired: Update the panel to make this plugin version available for installation.
staffDescription: Manage the support queue, reply to clients and review service access.
clientDescription: Your service conversations and temporary access permissions in one place.
workspaceLockedHelp: Service tools become available after the owner grants you active temporary access. Request access in the details panel. Access ends when permission expires, is revoked or the ticket is closed.
ticketUnavailable: This ticket could not be loaded. Check the link and your access permissions.
archivedTicketHelp: The service was deleted. This ticket and conversation are retained as read-only history; temporary access has been revoked.
SUPPORT_TICKET_ARCHIVED: This ticket is archived and read-only.
SUPPORT_STATUS_INVALID: This status transition is unavailable. Refresh the ticket.
SUPPORT_RATE_LIMITED: Too many operations. Wait a moment and try again.
SUPPORT_IDEMPOTENCY_INVALID: Invalid operation identifier. Refresh the page.
SUPPORT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This operation identifier was already used with different data. Refresh the page.
title: Support Center
ticketRoleAccessOptional: This role allows ticket handling. To use temporary service access, an administrator must also select support:access in the role permissions. Owner consent remains required.
grantAssigneeHelp: Grant access without waiting for a staff request. Consent applies only to the displayed person, selected scopes and duration. You can revoke it at any time.
ownerAccessNoAssignee: Once a staff member claims this ticket, you can grant temporary access here. You can also wait for their request and approve it.
staffAccessPermissionMissing: You can handle tickets but do not have support:access. An administrator must grant this role permission before you can request service access. Owner consent is still required.
SUPPORT_STAFF_ACCESS_REQUIRED: The assignee is inactive or lacks support:read and support:access. An administrator must grant the required role permissions. Service consent does not replace account permissions.
SUPPORT_ASSIGNEE_CHANGED: The ticket assignee changed. Refresh the ticket and check the recipient before granting access.
SUPPORT_SELF_ACCESS_DENIED: You cannot grant temporary access to yourself. As the owner, manage the service through its panel.
event_ACCESS_GRANTED_BY_OWNER: Owner granted temporary access to the assignee
staffOwnTicketHelp: You created this ticket. With ticket-management permissions you can claim it and change its status. Internal notes and granting service access to yourself remain unavailable.
ticketRoleReady: This role can read and manage support tickets.
ticketRoleMissing: This role is missing ticket-management permissions. The Support name or role protection alone does not allow claiming tickets.
enableTicketRoleHelp: Add support:read and support:manage to the selected Support role and protect it. This affects current role members. Other permissions and memberships are preserved. This does not add support:access or service file access.
assignStaffHelp: Then open the selected account → Roles and assign Support. Staff see the change when returning to the panel tab or refreshing permissions.
PLUGIN_ROLE_IS_DEFAULT: Support is the default role for new accounts. Select another unprivileged default role first to avoid granting staff access to all users.
callSupportHelp: Describe the problem with this service. Sending a ticket notifies support; it does not grant access to your service. Staff must request your separate consent.
description: Get help with your services and control temporary staff access.
previewNote: Interactive preview — sample data only. No database, agent or real services are modified.
installHelp: Installation creates a separate plugin_support_center database schema with tickets, messages, consent and audit history. It registers support permissions for Owner. No files are published. Installation creates the unassigned Support role with read and ticket-management permissions, without service access. An existing Support role is preserved.
confirmation: Type the plugin ID to confirm
uninstallHelp: Disable the plugin first. Preserve its data for reinstallation, or explicitly delete the separate schema.
deleteData: Delete all Support Center data permanently
notInstalled: Install Support Center to use real tickets. You can explore the preview without installing it.
error: The operation failed. Refresh and try again.
choose: Select a ticket to view messages and permissions.
subject: Subject
noServices: You have no services available for a ticket.
noAccess: No access requests. Staff must request consent before working on the service.
consentNote: Approve only the displayed scope and duration. You can revoke access at any time.
secretWarning: Files and logs may contain secrets. The additional secret-file scope includes .env and key files; review access carefully.
workspaceHelp: Each command is authorized by the backend against the current grant, ownership and expiry.
previewWorkspace: Preview does not connect to an agent. Install the plugin locally to test authorized service access.
notificationBody: Open the ticket to review the conversation or access request.
permission_access: Request and use temporary service access
permissionHelp: Support access always requires the service owner’s separate consent.
sampleMessage: The bot starts and then stops. Please help me check the project configuration.
sampleReason: I need to inspect the project files to diagnose the startup problem.
sampleResponse: Please approve read access if you want me to inspect the project files.
SUPPORT_DISABLED: Support Center is not installed or is disabled.
SUPPORT_NOT_FOUND: Ticket or access request not found.
SUPPORT_SCOPE_DENIED: Your permissions do not allow this operation.
SUPPORT_ACCESS_INACTIVE: Access is inactive, revoked or expired.
SUPPORT_SECRETS_DENIED: This file requires additional consent for secret files.
SUPPORT_OWNER_REQUIRED: Only the current service owner can approve this action.
SUPPORT_TICKET_CLOSED: This ticket is closed or the service owner has changed.
SUPPORT_TICKET_LIMIT: Too many open tickets. Close a ticket before creating another.
SUPPORT_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND: Service not found or not owned by your account.
PLUGIN_DISABLE_FIRST: Disable the plugin before uninstalling it.
PLUGIN_MIGRATION_CHANGED: The stored migration checksum differs. Installation was rolled back.
permissionsActive: Plugin enabled — assigned permissions are active. Service access still requires the owner’s consent.
permissionsInactive: Plugin disabled or uninstalled — its permissions are inactive. Role assignments and other permissions are preserved.
stateUnknown: Could not check the plugin status. Existing role assignments have not been changed.
roleProtectionHelp: The plugin manages this role. Its name and deletion are protected; permissions and user assignments remain editable.
roleBindingNeeded: Role not linked — confirm plugin ownership to enable protection
bindRoleHelp: This will link the selected role to Support Center and protect its name and deletion. Permissions and memberships will not change. It will also apply the role-metadata migration inside the plugin schema if needed.
roleIdConfirmation: Type the role ID to confirm
PLUGIN_ROLE_DELETE_PROTECTED: This plugin-managed role cannot be deleted while the plugin is installed.
PLUGIN_ROLE_NAME_PROTECTED: The name of a plugin-managed role cannot be changed.
PLUGIN_ROLE_NOT_FOUND: The selected role is not eligible for this plugin binding.
PLUGIN_ROLE_CREATE_CONFLICT: Another administrator created this role during installation. Retry to preserve that role.
upgradeHelp: This update adds assignment, read markers, internal notes and operation outcomes in the plugin schema. Existing tickets, roles and consents are preserved. Confirm the plugin ID to apply the reviewed migrations.
SUPPORT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED: Support Center needs a local update. An administrator can apply it from the plugin card in Marketplace.
internalNoteHelp: This note is visible only to support staff. It will not be sent to the client.
activeSupportAccess: Support has temporary access to this service
SUPPORT_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: Another staff member has already taken this ticket. Refresh before transferring it.
SUPPORT_ASSIGNMENT_INVALID: Choose an active support staff member other than the ticket owner.
SUPPORT_INTERNAL_DENIED: Internal notes are not available in the client role.
